evidence.finding: Public Securitize API resource center documents issuer/investor integration surfaces; no public ATS execution-history or OHLCV surface identified.
Documented API families are Domain API for issuers and Connect API for investors.
Investor API access uses OAuth, client_id, application secret and access tokens; it is not an unauthenticated public market-data feed.
Public BCAP trading page identifies Securitize Markets, last trade 2025-01-07, price USD 5.10, 24h volume 0.
Public BCAP overview states full trading history requires login; security is an LP fund interest and secondary marketplace is Securitize Markets.

reason: The exact BCAP secondary venue exists, but the preregistered frozen V2A contract requires public/auditable execution data sufficient for deterministic timestamp/schema continuity and OHLCV QA. The bounded physical qualification did not identify an official unauthenticated Securitize ATS trade-history, trade-stream, or OHLCV endpoint. The public third-party surface is stale/zero-volume and gates full history behind login. Authenticated issuer/investor APIs do not satisfy public-auditability, and NAV or ordinary token transfers cannot be silently reinterpreted as spot executions.
next_allowed_action: Reconcile BCAP as structurally unobservable under the current frozen contract or identify a materially distinct preregisterable public/auditable execution source. Do not reopen Securitize ATS without materially new public market-data capability.
